### `entasis_contact_tracker_bind`

binds contact history to one world and optional user table

binding begins a new event history. the first successfully drained step reports begin for every retained pair

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_collider_part_stepper_update(entasis_fixed_stepper_t * stepper, entasis_world_t * world, float elapsed, entasis_trigger_event_t * output, uint64_t capacity, entasis_collider_part_event_t * part_output, uint64_t part_capacity, entasis_collider_part_update_result_t * out_result, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| `output`        | `entasis_trigger_event_t *`               | parent event output                                   |
| `capacity`      | `uint64_t`                                | parent output capacity                                |
| `part_output`   | `entasis_collider_part_event_t *`         | part event output                                     |
| `part_capacity` | `uint64_t`                                | part output capacity                                  |
| `out_result`    | `entasis_collider_part_update_result_t *` | completed-time/output/pending result                  |

### `entasis_collider_part_stepper_update_with_contacts`

drains contact and both trigger streams before each following fixed physics step

part subscription is required. contact history is drained before trigger streams. delivered contacts remain delivered if a trigger batch is short. both trigger streams are acknowledged together. all pending streams block further physics. retry with elapsed zero. completed_steps never counts the same step twice. tracker capacity failure may require contact_tracker_ensure_capacity in addition to larger output. wrong-world, disposed or skipped-history trackers are rejected before accepting elapsed time. output arrays, result, stepper and handles must be disjoint. no allocation or automatic history reset occurs

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_collider_part_stepper_update_with_contacts(entasis_fixed_stepper_t * stepper, entasis_world_t * world, float elapsed, entasis_trigger_event_t * output, uint64_t capacity, entasis_collider_part_event_t * part_output, uint64_t part_capacity, entasis_contact_tracker_t * tracker, entasis_contact_event_t * contact_output, uint64_t contact_capacity, entasis_collider_part_contact_update_result_t * out_result, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter          | C type                                            | Meaning                                                                                   |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stepper`          | `entasis_fixed_stepper_t *`                       | caller-owned accumulator                                                                  |
| `world`            | `entasis_world_t *`                               | target world                                                                              |
| `elapsed`          | `float`                                           | nonnegative elapsed time. use zero for delivery retry                                     |
| `output`           | `entasis_trigger_event_t *`                       | parent event output                                                                       |
| `capacity`         | `uint64_t`                                        | parent output capacity                                                                    |
| `part_output`      | `entasis_collider_part_event_t *`                 | part event output                                                                         |
| `part_capacity`    | `uint64_t`                                        | part output capacity                                                                      |
| `tracker`          | `entasis_contact_tracker_t *`                     | ready tracker bound to the same world. at current or immediately preceding completed step |
| `contact_output`   | `entasis_contact_event_t *`                       | caller-owned contact output                                                               |
| `contact_capacity` | `uint64_t`                                        | contact output capacity                                                                   |
| `out_result`       | `entasis_collider_part_contact_update_result_t *` | completed-time/output/pending result                                                      |
| `diagnostic`       | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`                          | optional diagnostic                                                                       |

OK on success or the first failure status

### `entasis_joint_break_stepper_update`

advances fixed steps with combined break and event delivery

joint breaks must be enabled. enabled parent and part subscriptions participate automatically. NULL tracker requires empty contact output. inactive streams accept empty output only. consume written prefixes once and retry elapsed=0 after backpressure. successful physics time is consumed even when later publication or delivery fails

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_joint_break_stepper_update(entasis_fixed_stepper_t * stepper, entasis_world_t * world, float elapsed, entasis_joint_break_event_t * break_output, uint64_t break_capacity, entasis_trigger_event_t * output, uint64_t capacity, entasis_collider_part_event_t * part_output, uint64_t part_capacity, entasis_contact_tracker_t * tracker, entasis_contact_event_t * contact_output, uint64_t contact_capacity, entasis_joint_break_update_result_t * out_result, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter          | C type                                  | Meaning                                                       |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
